entities.name: Denis Zvizdić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Denis Zvizdić is a Bosnian politician who served as Chairman of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina from 2015 to 2019. He has been serving as member of the national House of Representatives since 2019. He also served as Prime Minister of Sarajevo Canton from 2003 to 2006.

entities.summary: Denis Zvizdić is a Bosnian politician who served as Chairman of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina from 2015 to 2019. He has been serving as member of the national House of Representatives since 2019. He also served as Prime Minister of Sarajevo Canton from 2003 to 2006.
